name: logo
description: University of Iowa lockup: black tab containing the gold Block IOWA (or IOWA Health Care) inline SVG, linking to the appropriate home page. Rendered inside the Brand Bar (header context) and Brand Footer (footer context).

options.name: healthcare
options.description: Switches lockup to IOWA Health Care, link to uihealthcare.org, and larger icon sizing

options.name: context
options.description: header renders .logo--tab (black tab); footer renders .logo--footer (no tab, transparent, sized by width — logo/footer/width tokens)

options.name: size
options.description: Figma-only axis. In code the narrow sizing is applied by the parent .iowa-bar--narrow selector, not a Logo prop

code.notes: No prop — driven by parent brand-bar narrow styling (brand-bar.scss .iowa-bar--narrow .logo--tab)

options.name: id
options.description: DOM id used for aria-labelledby on the SVG title

a11y.notes: Accessible name via .element-invisible text inside the link ('University of Iowa' / 'The University of Iowa Health Care'); svg has role=img and aria-labelledby pointing at the <title> id

behavior: Figma note: logo/icon/height/* tokens size the lockup vectors at BUILD time (per variant) rather than being live-bound — binding height alone would distort the vector; tab dims and fills ARE live-bound

healthcare-lockup.source: Logo.vue template (.logo-text paths = HEALTH CARE wordmark, fill white)

knownIssues: Healthcare in footer context applies the header-tuned icon height (logo/icon/height/healthcare) — no footer-specific healthcare sizing exists in 4.x
